def drive(me, enemy, arena):
    angle = bearing_to(enemy.x, enemy.y)
    turn = max(-1, min(1, angle / 65.0 - me.turn_rate / 220.0))
    a = abs(angle)

    if a < 55:
        forward = 1.0
    elif a < 110:
        forward = 0.35
    else:
        forward = 0.0

    left = max(-1, min(1, forward - turn))
    right = max(-1, min(1, forward + turn))
    return (left, right)


def weapons(me, enemy, arena):
    w = me.weapons.get("front", {})

    if w.get("type") != "flipper":
        return None

    if (me.inverted and not me.righting and not me.airborne
            and me.battery_wh > 0 and w["health"] > 0
            and w["ready"] and w["shots_left"] > 0):
        return self_right()

    dist = distance_to(enemy.x, enemy.y)
    angle = abs(bearing_to(enemy.x, enemy.y))
    reach = 0.5 * (me.length + enemy.length) + 0.38

    if (not me.inverted and not me.on_side and not me.airborne
            and not me.righting and me.battery_wh > 0
            and w["ready"] and w["shots_left"] > 0
            and not enemy.inverted and not enemy.on_side
            and not enemy.airborne and not enemy.righting
            and not enemy.held and not enemy.lifted
            and dist <= reach and angle < 28):
        return flip("front")

    return None
